import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' column to datetime
data['date'] = pd.to_datetime(data['date'])

# Calculate daily total sales
daily_sales = data.groupby('date')['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Set the style of the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create the plot
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 7))
sns.lineplot(x='date', y='total', data=daily_sales, marker='o', linewidth=2.5)

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Date', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Daily Total Sales at Coffee Shop', fontsize=16)

# Rotate the x-ticks for better readability
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' column to datetime
data['date'] = pd.to_datetime(data['date'])

# Calculate daily total sales
daily_sales = data.groupby('date')['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Set the style of the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create the plot
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 7))
sns.lineplot(x='date', y='total', data=daily_sales, marker='o', linewidth=2.5)

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Date', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Daily Total Sales at Coffee Shop', fontsize=16)

# Rotate the x-ticks for better readability
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
